footer.tagline: Our motto is: Look beyond the window. Create with authenticity. Make an impact with purpose.
home.hero.headline: We build brands with purpose, strategy, and expression.
home.hero.sub: Ikigai is a branding and content agency that turns the essence of brands into strategic positioning.
home.intro.title: Our purpose is to spark yours.
home.intro.text1: We believe a brand isn't built only by what it publishes, but by everything it communicates, delivers, and makes someone feel.
home.intro.text2: That's why we bring together branding, strategy, content, and storytelling to build brands that are coherent from essence to experience.
home.intro.text3: Here, every project starts with a question: what's the purpose that needs to take shape?
home.audience.title: For brands that know they have something special, but need to communicate it clearly.
home.audience.text1: We work with entrepreneurs, personal brands, service businesses, and companies that want to grow without losing their essence.
home.audience.text2: Brands that don't just want to show up, but to build meaning, recognition, and connection.
home.audience.1.title: For those just starting out
home.audience.1.text: Who need to build a brand with direction from day one.
home.audience.2.title: For those growing
home.audience.2.text: Who notice their communication no longer matches the size of the business.
home.audience.3.title: For those repositioning
home.audience.3.text: Who need to align essence, strategy, and expression with a new phase.
home.services.title: Main Services
home.services.1.desc: We take care of your brand's entire communication, from planning to publishing, to build consistent positioning, presence, and growth.
home.services.2.desc: We develop writing, design, editing, and video production for brands that need strategic content ready to publish.
home.services.3.desc: We turn events, launches, trips, and experiences into strategic stories, produced and published in real time.
home.services.4.name: Profile Analysis
home.services.4.desc: A strategic session to identify gaps, opportunities, and next steps to strengthen your digital presence.
home.services.5.desc: We map essence, purpose, differentiators, and positioning to build a clear direction before you communicate, grow, or reposition.
home.services.6.desc: We build brands from the ground up, combining strategy, naming, and visual identity to create a presence with purpose and personality.
home.services.7.desc: Websites, catalogs, presentations, e-books, and materials for launches or events, built around your brand's needs.
home.method.title: The Ikigai Method
home.method.intro1: We don't start with the post. We start with the brand.
home.method.intro2: Our process turns what makes a business unique into strategic, recognizable, and coherent communication.
home.method.1.title: Essence
home.method.1.text: We investigate purpose, history, values, audience, and everything that sustains the brand.
home.method.2.title: Strategy
home.method.2.text: We define positioning, message, objectives, and the paths that guide communication.
home.method.3.title: Expression
home.method.3.text: We turn strategy into identity, content, language, and presence.
home.method.4.title: Experience
home.method.4.text: We build touchpoints that make the brand perceived, remembered, and felt.

home.diff.title1: We're a boutique agency. That means every project here is one of a kind.
home.diff.title2: Get ready to meet your new favorite agency. Much more than an agency, a partner for your brand.
home.diff.1.title: Strategic vision
home.diff.1.text: Every creative decision starts from an objective, a positioning, and an intention.
home.diff.2.title: Close creative direction
home.diff.2.text: We follow each brand in a personalized way, respecting its essence and the moment the business is in.
home.diff.3.title: Branding applied to communication
home.diff.3.text: We don't treat branding as a standalone deliverable. It guides every piece of content, campaign, and experience.
home.diff.4.title: Storytelling with purpose
home.diff.4.text: We turn stories, values, and ideas into narratives that create identification.
home.diff.5.title: Excellence with simplicity
home.diff.5.text: We look for depth in our process and clarity in how we communicate.
home.testimonials.title: What the brands that trusted us are saying:
home.testimonials.1.quote: The result was incredible! You truly understood the essence of our brand.
home.testimonials.2.quote: The event coverage was flawless. The stories brought engagement we had never seen before.
home.testimonials.3.quote: Our profile grew organically and consistently. Highly recommend!
home.testimonials.4.quote: The branding completely changed the perception of our brand. Clients comment on it every week.
home.testimonials.5.quote: The videos had more reach than any content we've ever produced. Incredible quality!
home.finalCta.title: Your brand already has an essence. Our job is to make the world able to perceive it.
home.finalCta.text: Whether you're starting out, growing, or going through a new phase, we can build a strategy that translates what makes your brand unique.
about.hero.headline: We are more than a marketing agency: we are builders of authentic narratives.
about.hero.photoAlt: Julia and Luiz holding hands beneath a red Japanese temple gate in Tokyo
about.hero.sub: We create strategies that reflect each brand's unique essence, elevating its presence in a sophisticated, creative way that connects with the right audience.
about.essence.title: Our essence
about.essence.text1: Ikigai is a Japanese word that represents what gives life meaning: the reason we wake up every day. It was from this concept that the agency was born.
about.essence.text2: We believe strong brands aren't built just to sell. They come from an intention, a story, and something true worth sharing. That's why our purpose is to spark the purpose of every brand that comes to us.
about.essence.text3: We dive into your story, understand your vision, and turn everything that makes you unique into a clear, authentic, and relevant strategy.
about.essence.text4: Because when a brand recognizes its essence, it stops merely communicating and starts occupying a place of its own in the world.
about.founders.title: Who's behind Ikigai
about.founders.1.photoAlt: Julia Rocha, founder and creative director of Ikigai, in a lantern-lit alley in Japan
about.founders.1.bio1: Ju is the creative and strategic mind behind Ikigai.
about.founders.1.bio2: Passionate about branding, storytelling, and the power a good narrative has to transform how a brand is perceived, she stays close to every project, leading strategy, positioning, and the agency's creative direction.
about.founders.1.bio3: Her path between Brazil and Japan broadened her view on culture, behavior, experience, and communication — references that are now part of Ikigai's essence and the careful way each brand is built.
about.founders.1.bio4: Julia believes branding is in everything: in the message, the aesthetics, the experience, the details, and above all, in how a brand makes people feel.
about.founders.1.bio5: Her work is helping businesses and entrepreneurs find clarity about who they are and turn that essence into an authentic, strategic, and memorable presence.
about.founders.2.photoAlt: Luiz Eduardo Umeda, co-founder and director of operations of Ikigai, in a lantern-lit alley in Japan
about.founders.2.bio1: Luiz is responsible for turning vision into structure.
about.founders.2.bio2: Leading Ikigai's finance, operations, and administrative areas, he organizes the processes that let every project be developed with clarity, consistency, and excellence.
about.founders.2.bio3: His analytical, strategic eye complements the agency's creative direction, connecting planning, feasibility, and execution.
about.founders.2.bio4: Alongside Julia, Luiz takes part in building and growing Ikigai, making sure the client experience is backed by an organized, close, and reliable operation.
about.founders.together: Together, Julia and Luiz bring together creativity and structure, sensitivity and strategy, purpose and execution.
about.abroad.title: Our team abroad
about.abroad.intro: Our international presence lets us stay close to brands and projects in the United States too, combining strategy, relationships, and local content production.
about.abroad.1.photoAlt: Ana Lima, Ikigai's sales representative in the United States, in Chicago
about.abroad.1.bio1: Ana represents Ikigai in the North American market, building connections with brands, entrepreneurs, and companies looking to strengthen their communication and positioning.
about.abroad.1.bio2: She handles the first business contacts, presents the agency's solutions, and helps identify how Ikigai can contribute to each business.
about.abroad.2.photoAlt: João Pedro, Ikigai's videomaker in the United States, in Times Square, New York
about.abroad.2.bio1: João Pedro is responsible for turning strategies and creative concepts into images.
about.abroad.2.bio2: With a close eye for movement, atmosphere, and detail, he handles the audiovisual production of Ikigai's projects in the United States.
about.abroad.3.photoAlt: Beatriz, Ikigai's social media and videomaker in Italy, in Venice
about.abroad.3.bio1: Beatriz combines content strategy and audiovisual production.
about.abroad.3.bio2: As social media manager and videomaker, she takes part in building brand narratives and turns ideas into dynamic, creative content connected to the audience.
about.abroad.3.bio3: Her local presence keeps her close to clients' routines, behind the scenes, and experiences in Italy, bringing authenticity and speed to production.
about.perspectives.title: One team, different perspectives
about.perspectives.text1: Every professional at Ikigai brings a unique perspective. Strategy, branding, creative direction, social media, audiovisual production, relationships, and operations connect so every project is built in a complete, coherent way.
about.perspectives.text2: We don't believe in generic solutions. We believe in listening, depth, and closeness. That's why we work side by side with every client, respecting their story, their moment, and their goals.
about.closing.title: Authentic brands start from within
about.closing.text1: Before thinking about how a brand will be seen, we seek to understand who it really is.
about.closing.text2: It's from that essence that the strategies, content, narratives, and experiences we create come from. Because a brand might catch attention with its aesthetics, but it's the truth behind it that makes someone stay.
about.closing.mantra: Our purpose is to spark yours.
services.hero.headline: Strategy, creativity, and purpose at every touchpoint
services.hero.sub: Every brand has a different essence, story, moment, and set of goals. That's why our solutions are built in a personalized way, starting from what makes each business unique.
services.1.text1: We take care of your brand's entire communication so you can focus on what really matters: leading and growing your business.
services.1.text2: Every piece of content is designed to strengthen your presence, communicate value, and build a genuine relationship with the right audience.
services.1.audience: For brands that want to outsource their communication and count on a strategic team handling the whole process, from idea to publication.
services.2.tagline: Content and visuals designed to truly communicate
services.2.text1: We bring together writing, design, editing, and audiovisual production so you receive content aligned with your brand and only have to worry about publishing.
services.2.text2: The service can be hired in different formats, according to the needs of the project.
services.2.audience: For brands that need professional content but don't require full social media management.

services.4.tagline: A strategic look at your digital presence
services.4.text1: It's not always easy to see what's keeping a brand from moving forward.
services.4.text2: During this online session, we analyze your digital presence to identify what's misaligned, what can evolve, where your communication loses strength, and which opportunities aren't being used yet.
services.4.audience: For brands, professionals, and entrepreneurs who feel their profile doesn't represent the full potential of the business, but don't yet know exactly what needs to change.
services.5.tagline: Before communicating a brand, you have to understand what's behind it.
services.5.text1: Brand DNA is a strategic process for businesses that need to define their essence, organize their ideas, and build a clear direction before moving on to content or visual identity.
services.5.audience: For brands that are starting out, repositioning, or growing without a clear strategic foundation.

services.5.group.2.title: Strategic analysis
services.5.group.3.title: Brand direction
services.6.text1: We build brands from strategy through to visual identity. It's a complete process for turning an idea into a brand with purpose, personality, and a visual expression that matches what it wants to represent.
services.6.text2: Branding doesn't start with the logo. First we understand the essence, the market, and the brand's direction. Then we turn that strategy into a name, an identity, and a visual language.
services.6.audience: For businesses being born or that need to completely rebuild their brand.

services.7.tagline: Didn't find what you're looking for?
services.7.text1: Some needs don't fit into a fixed service. We also develop custom projects, combining strategy, content, design, and creative direction according to each brand's goals.
services.7.text2: We look at each request individually to understand the scope, the goals, and which professionals need to take part in the project.
services.7.text3: There's a good chance we can build a custom solution for your brand.
services.choose.title: How do you choose the right service?
services.choose.text1: You don't need to come to us knowing exactly which solution to hire.
services.choose.text2: During the first conversation, we understand your brand's moment, your challenges, and your goals so we can point to the most suitable path.
services.choose.text3: Part of our job is helping you identify that need.
